# Adopt PowerShell example

PowerShell tree with a `greet` package and a stdlib-only `solo` package.

```sh
bazel run //dx/launch:dx -- init //powershell/tests/fixtures/adopt_powershell/...
bazel run //dx/launch:dx -- generate //powershell/tests/fixtures/adopt_powershell/...
bazel build //powershell/tests/fixtures/adopt_powershell/...
bazel test //powershell/tests/fixtures/adopt_powershell/...
```

Both tests pass (`greet_test`, `pure_test`).
